# SatGate: economic firewall for agent workloads
> Give agents bounded authority for useful work. Protect the resources behind it.
> Observe / Control / Admit, with signed evidence across all three controls.

## Purpose
SatGate puts applicable economic and authority checks in the path to protected APIs and tools. External paid admission imposes a caller cost before resource consumption where owner policy requires payment. Internal agents consume a finite owner-controlled allowance. Payment never overrides scope, expiry, revocation or tenant boundaries.

Economic friction is deterrence, not immunity from funded attackers. Operators must bound rejection, invoice-creation and verification costs as well as legitimate-task overhead. Observe alone does not block requests.

## Core controls

### Observe
Meter and attribute agent/API traffic without blocking it.

### Control
Enforce budget and scope on requests through the gateway. Fiat402 is internal budget control, not a payment or settlement rail. It does not require Lightning payment; an internal ledger debit is not external settlement.

### Admit
Authorize external agents with scoped access. Require and verify payment only where the configured route policy calls for it. Charge/L402 is an optional settlement rail, not a fourth control.

## Proof across all three controls
Evidence Packs record governed decisions across HTTP and MCP paths. Verify issuer trust, canonical bytes and signatures independently. A valid receipt does not prove answer quality, supplier truth, legal identity or external settlement. A cooperative agent trial does not prove attack deterrence.

## Agent choice and owner enforcement
Agents may choose SatGate for useful work. The resource boundary must remain owner-enforced regardless of that choice. Restrict direct origin access, upstream credentials and egress so callers cannot bypass the gateway. A voluntarily installed wrapper or a pre-run check of an old receipt does not establish that protection.

## Discovery and availability
- Start here: https://satgate.io/build
- Trust metadata and adapter status: https://satgate.io/.well-known/satgate
- Public source: https://github.com/SatGate-io/satgate
- Synthetic HTTP demo and cleanup instructions: https://github.com/SatGate-io/satgate/tree/main/demo
- Browser simulation: https://satgate.io/sandbox#golden-path
- Request a bounded evaluation: https://satgate.io/design-partners

The public demo uses simulated traffic and local-only credentials. It does not establish trusted issuer identity, delegated-worker accounting, MCP behavior or live settlement. Installing a public SDK does not grant hosted API access. The issue/pay/verify API namespace is in private beta. Fresh-agent evaluations with delegated workers require separately confirmed setup and authority; these links do not advertise a public evaluation installer.

Trust metadata distinguishes supported and planned adapters. AgentCore Payments and Pay.sh are planned. A discovery document describes availability; exercise the chosen adapter before making a runtime-support claim.

## Delegation, refusal and recovery
Choose a useful task with a finite budget. Delegate narrower authority and reservation capacity to each worker before starting. Test out-of-scope and exhausted-budget refusal separately from answer quality. After an ambiguous result, check whether the selected deployment can recover the same operation before retrying. Test its duplicate-spend handling; an unknown outcome remains unresolved, not a failed call. Evaluate useful completion, abuse protection, voluntary adoption and commercial demand separately.

## L402 flow on a configured paid route
1. Request a protected endpoint.
2. Receive a payment-required challenge when policy requires it.
3. An authorized payer pays the invoice within the delegated allowance.
4. Retry with the required payment proof and scoped credentials.
5. The gateway validates payment and authorization before forwarding.

## Architecture
```
Agent / App / MCP Client → CDN/WAF → SatGate Policy-to-Proof Gateway → API / MCP Server / Model Provider
```

SatGate can be deployed as a gateway, sidecar, or MCP proxy. It is designed to add economic governance around existing APIs and agent workflows without forcing every tool implementation to be rewritten.
